summary: CCM (convergent cross mapping) reveals unidirectional causal link: cloud area fraction causally drives TOA albedo (p=0.020, ρ converges 0.25→0.48 globally; SH: 0.43→0.62), but albedo does NOT causally drive cloud area (p=0.053, non-convergent). Cloud optical depth (tau) also causally drives albedo (p=0.0006). This supports H001 cloud buffering hypothesis: clouds are the causal agent regulating albedo, not the other way around.
